name: Sea Island Resort
insider_take: This legendary Georgian resort sits on a pristine barrier island where five U.S. presidents have vacationed and the world's elite have gathered for nearly a century of refined Southern hospitality.
whats_special: The Cloister is one of only 64 Forbes Five-Star resorts worldwide, featuring three championship golf courses including the Ocean Forest Golf Club ranked among America's top 100. The resort's Beach Club was the training site for the 2004 U.S. Olympic shooting team, and its Spanish Mediterranean architecture houses priceless antiques and artwork collected by the original owners.
pro_tip: Book a sunset horseback ride on the beach - Sea Island is one of the few places in Georgia where you can ride horses directly on the sand, a tradition dating back to the 1920s.
dont_miss: The Lodge at Sea Island Golf Club's whiskey library with over 300 rare selections, and a visit to the Sea Island Forge where resident blacksmith creates custom ironwork using traditional techniques. The nearby Christ Church Frederica hosts weddings in the same chapel where Charles Wesley, co-founder of Methodism, once preached.
pros: Historic luxury resort with timeless Southern elegance and charm
Exceptional championship golf courses and world-class spa facilities
Private beach access with pristine Atlantic Ocean coastline
Award-winning dining experiences with farm-to-table cuisine
cons: Secluded island location requires travel planning
